thread.title: Dow erases triple-digit stumble to momentarily turn positive in intraday action

author: morningstar.com
title: Dow erases triple-digit stumble to momentarily turn positive in intraday action
text:
The Dow Jones Industrial Average wiped out a triple-digit slide to pivot in to the green on Friday, with shares of Apple Inc. (AAPL) and Exxon Mobil Corp. (XOM) helping offset a slide in shares of Boeing Co. (BA). The Dow traded flat at 25,995 at 25,993, with Boeing's decline 2.5% tempering a slide in shares of Apple and Exxon, with each climbing by at least 1%. The Dow had been down by as many as 107.45 points at Friday's lows, following the August jobs report. Meanwhile, the S&P 500 index and the Nasdaq Composite Index were both trading in positive territory after opening firmly lower.
-Mark DeCambre; 1151ET
